text:
Samira Patel: hey product folks 👋 first day here! i tried opening the Redwood Design Figma file but i get a permissions error. can someone add me? email samira.patel@redwood.ai
Maya Lee: welcome Samira!! i'll add you in a sec. what's your Figma email?
Samira Patel: samira.patel@redwood.ai — thank you!! also quick q: where do you keep the single-source-of-truth roadmap docs? i found an old notion page but not sure if it's the latest
onboarding-bot: Hi Samira — I've created a checklist for new product hires: 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #product-sync 3) Read Q2 roadmap (Notion) 4) Schedule intro w/ PM pair. Link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/new-hire-checklist
Maya Lee: added you to the Figma team and the shared file (you should get an invite). roadmap lives in Notion under Product > Roadmap > Active. Jacob keeps the canonical timeline there.
Jacob Ortiz: tagged — hey Samira, welcome! main roadmap is here: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/product-roadmap (please DM if something looks off). for context, we snapshot the roadmap weekly and mark PRDs in the "In Review" section.
Samira Patel: got the figma invite, thanks Maya :tada: — seeing layers ok now. Jacob — do we have a primer on our research process and how to get user studies scheduled? first week i'd like to ramp on recent research and any open interview slots
Liam Chen: hey Samira — welcome! design ops handles recruiting/building study templates. short answer: requests go through /design/research-requests in Notion, then we triage on Thurs ASync. i'll ping you templates and a calendar with available slots.
Maya Lee: also FYI — we do "design pairing" sessions Tue/Thu mornings. good way to meet folks and go over mocks. i'll put you on next Tue's invite.
Samira Patel: sweet — thanks everyone. one last thing: who should I ask about design token usage in the shared library? i want to avoid accidentally publishing breaking changes
Maya Lee: ping me for tokens, but production token publishes are gated by the platform team. tag @Liam Chen and @Jacob Ortiz in the PR and we do a quick review.
Jacob Ortiz: we also have a short checklist in the tokens page: update changelog, run visual diff, and schedule a 15m review. i'll point you at the page after lunch.
Samira Patel: perfect. appreciate the quick help — excited to get started! :rocket:
Maya Lee: happy to have you! if anything else blocks access, DM me or drop in #devex. we try to keep onboarding friction low.
Liam Chen: welcome again — i'll share the study templates and the next triage notes in this thread in a bit.
Samira Patel: thanks — will sync after i finish the onboarding checklist. :)
